_comment: SCHEMA ONLY - no persona content. The pipeline builds every search's personas from the user's own description in the web UI; this file only defines the JSON shape and the allowed values. Do not copy values from here.
industry: <short industry / market name derived from the user's description>
sectors: <buyer or customer sectors relevant to the description>
hubs: <cities / industrial hubs in the region relevant to the description>

icps.code: P1  (use P1, P2, P3 ... one per distinct persona in the user's description)
icps.name: <short label for this persona>
icps.company_rule: ONE OF: exhibitor_3plus (company exhibits at 3+ trade shows in 12 months) | exhibitor (exhibits at a show) | visitor (company visits/buys at shows) | visitor_or_exhibitor | any (no show requirement)
icps.find_via: ONE OF: company_list (find the companies via trade shows first, then the people) | industry_search (search people directly by title x sector x city)
title_keywords: <lower-case substrings that identify the role in a LinkedIn headline>
exclude_keywords: <lower-case substrings that disqualify, e.g. intern, trainee, student>
buys_at_shows: <only for buyer personas: what they source at shows>

functions: ANY OF: purchasing, sales, business_development, operations, marketing
seniority: ANY OF: senior, strategic, manager, director, vp, cxo, owner
